time_roles.event_time: immutable source observation time used for windows and replay
time_roles.ingest_time: Kafka record timestamp assigned by the admitted producer or broker
time_roles.processing_time: explicit runtime clock used only for diagnostics and as_of capping
time_roles.watermark: lower bound of event-time progress emitted by the source strategy

wire_requirements.timezone: wire values are UTC instants; local timestamps without an explicit offset must be rejected before conversion
wire_requirements.replay: classification receives every clock value as input and never reads the wall clock

rollout.kubernetes_effect: takes effect only in images built from this source and deployed by an approved rollout
rollout.state_migration: none; keyed max-event-time state name remains unchanged
rollout.rollback: redeploy the previous immutable image; Kafka source offsets and DLQ records remain durable

proves: one strict boundary and overflow rule are implemented across four Flink consumers
future time, rollback, lateness and as_of are deterministic under replay
does_not_prove: a candidate image has been deployed to Kubernetes
all historical producers already emit valid event and ingest time
